lemmas.primary_translation: make a fuss about; attach too much importance to

definitions.text: lage (for) mye oppstuss omkring noe eller noen
definitions.translation: make a (too great) fuss about something or someone

examples.no: barnet oppførte seg lydig og pent og gjorde lite vesen av seg
examples.en: the child behaved obediently and nicely and did not draw much attention to themself
